description: This file contains the implementation of the ChunkFileUploadService class, which manages chunked file uploads, including processing upload requests, handling temporary files, and cleaning up old temporary files within the OrchardCore media module.

classes.name: ChunkFileUploadService
classes.description: A service class that handles chunked file uploads, including processing upload requests, managing temporary files, and cleaning up expired temporary files.

classes.name: ChunkedFormFile
classes.description: A private nested class implementing IFormFile and IDisposable, representing a chunked form file backed by a stream.

methods.name: ProcessRequestAsync
methods.description: Processes an HTTP request for uploading a file chunk, handling validation, writing to temporary storage, and determining if the upload is complete.

methods.name: CompleteUploadAsync
methods.description: Finalizes the upload process by reading the temporary file and invoking the completion callback, then deletes the temporary file.

methods.name: PurgeTempDirectory
methods.description: Deletes expired temporary files based on configured lifetime.

methods.name: DeleteTemporaryFile
methods.description: Deletes a temporary file given its path or upload ID and form file.

methods.name: GetOrCreateTemporaryFile
methods.description: Retrieves an existing temporary file stream or creates a new one for uploading chunks.

methods.name: GetTemporaryFileForRead
methods.description: Creates a ChunkedFormFile object for reading a completed upload from temporary storage.

methods.name: GetTempFolderPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the temporary folder used for storing upload chunks.

methods.name: GetTempFilePath
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary file path based on upload ID and file info.

methods.name: CreateTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a new temporary file with a specified size and sets it as temporary.

methods.name: CalculateHash
methods.description: Calculates a hash string from multiple string parts using XxHash64.
